about: Backup retention at two thresholds by region (14 days in eu-west-1, 7 elsewhere, by region conditions on a regional type): one bullet, or one per region naming the other.

source.name: rds-retention-eu
source.description: EU databases keep two weeks of backups.

source.name: rds-retention
source.description: Databases keep a week of backups.

controls.output: - RDS instances with `BackupRetentionPeriod` under 14 in eu-west-1 (HIGH, GDPR), or under 7 in other regions (MEDIUM, ORG), are flagged. Instances meeting their region's minimum pass. Reports only. acme:rds-retention-eu@1 acme:rds-retention@1

- RDS instances in eu-west-1 with `BackupRetentionPeriod` under 14 are flagged; elsewhere the minimum is 7. Others pass. HIGH, GDPR; reports only. acme:rds-retention-eu@1
- RDS instances outside eu-west-1 with `BackupRetentionPeriod` under 7 are flagged; eu-west-1 needs 14. Others pass. MEDIUM, ORG; reports only. acme:rds-retention@1

- RDS instances in eu-west-1 with `BackupRetentionPeriod` under 14 are flagged. Others pass. HIGH, GDPR; reports only. acme:rds-retention-eu@1
- RDS instances with `BackupRetentionPeriod` under 7 are flagged. Others pass. MEDIUM, ORG; reports only. acme:rds-retention@1

- RDS instances in eu-west-1 with `BackupRetentionPeriod` under 14 are flagged; instances outside eu-west-1 pass this check. HIGH, GDPR; reports only. acme:rds-retention-eu@1
- RDS instances outside eu-west-1 with `BackupRetentionPeriod` under 7 are flagged. Instances in eu-west-1 pass this check. MEDIUM, ORG; reports only. acme:rds-retention@1
